planner.decision_variable: sequence of H action pairs (supply-temperature setpoint, fan)
planner.applied: first action only, re-solved every control step
planner.forecast_source: envs.tsup_features.WeatherLookup, the same ambient forecast that feeds the agent's 17-D observation. Neither controller gets privileged information.
planner.objective: Quadratic comfort-band violation plus normalised energy, mirroring the structure of the RL training reward. NOT the evaluation metric m_s: optimising the metric being reported would flatter the baseline.
